verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs say it reviews the full codebase rather than just the diff, and that it catches breaking changes and design deviations that diff-only tools miss. Its centralized rules and Rule Miner, which mines PR history, cover existing conventions, and governance maps how repositories and services connect. However, the full-codebase claim is stated explicitly only for the PR summary, and call-site and related-module analysis inside review findings is implied rather than documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation that review findings trace call sites and related modules, detail on how repository-wide context is gathered for findings, independent or hands-on corroboration of whole-repo-aware review comments.

support.subject: As a developer, review comments reflect the whole repository — call sites, related modules, existing conventions — not just the changed hunks

catching breaking changes, spec gaps, and design deviations that diff-only tools miss.
